metadata.title: as_strided_backward in expanded case & dynamically created grad_fn for views

trigger_conditions.condition: Applying view operations that create memory aliasing (such as as_strided, expand, or reshape) on tensors requiring gradients, followed by backward computation.
trigger_conditions.operation_context: Applying as_strided or reshape to an expanded tensor that requires gradients, then computing gradients; for example, x.expand(3,2).as_strided([3,2], x.expand(3,2).stride()) followed by a differentiable operation.

failure_behavior.description: Applying as_strided or reshape to an expanded tensor that requires gradients, then computing gradients; for example, x.expand(3,2).as_strided([3,2], x.expand(3,2).stride()) followed by a differentiable operation.
